## Analysis

The question asks to complete the sentence: "Il ___ quand l'accident s'est produit" (He ___ when the accident happened).

Since "s'est produit" (happened) is in the passé composé (past tense), we need to determine which form of "conduire" (to drive) is most appropriate.

A. "conduisait" - imparfait tense (was driving)
B. "conduira" - future tense (will drive)
C. "conduirait" - conditional tense (would drive)
D. "conduit" - passé composé (drove/has driven)

The imparfait tense "conduisait" is the correct choice because it describes an ongoing action in the past that was happening when another event occurred. This is a classic use of the imparfait to set a background action that was interrupted by a specific event.
